name: paper_repair
notes: Paper-scale repair loop. Main dataset = repairable negatives (drop_w_term, flip_w_sign, r_charge_perturb, rank_perturb). positive (do-no-harm) and wrong_pair (abstention) are secondary stress sets included via --include-non-repairable. Feedback verifier uses L=3; final-eval verifier uses the stricter L=5 (anti-gaming guardrail: the R<=5 operator set strictly contains R<=3). NOT L=6: under the R-graded chiral ring L bounds total R, so families with R=1/3 fields (dp0) admit ~18-letter words at R<=6 -- measured 56s/verifier-call at L=6 vs 0.02s at L=5 on the dp0 depth-1 drop_w pair (2026-07-14); L=5 across all 31 depth-1 smoke pairs totals <1s.
